summary: Mapa tab feature end-to-end verified. Backend: 8/8 pytest passing including expanded /api/comunas assertions (subset check + sorted). Frontend at 390x844 web preview: all 5 tabs present (tab-home, tab-categorias, tab-favoritos, tab-mapa, tab-info) navigate correctly; tab-mapa opens mapa-screen with header 'Mapa de talleres' and subtitle '12 talleres'. Chip row shows comuna-all + 11 comuna-{name} chips (El Bosque, La Florida, Las Condes, Maipú, Providencia, Puente Alto, Recoleta, San Joaquín, Santiago, Vitacura, Ñuñoa). map-web fallback renders grouped-by-comuna list as expected (react-native-maps is native-only). Tapping comuna-Las Condes filters list to 2 rows and subtitle becomes '2 talleres en Las Condes'. comuna-all resets back to 12 rows. Tapping map-row-{id} navigates to /workshop/{id}. Regression checks: Inicio (logo, chips, list, turbo-fab -> /chat), Categorias, Favoritos, Info tabs all work; workshop detail still works. Deprecated shadow* / props.pointerEvents warnings observed (pre-existing, non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Pre-existing, non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.card, shadow.floating). Note: WorkshopsMap.native.tsx uses shadow.floating for the bottom card.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Pre-existing, likely internal to expo-router / RN Web.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Migrate shadow.* props to boxShadow in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to silence RN Web deprecation warning (also used by WorkshopsMap.native card).
No functional issues to fix. Feature is complete and correct.
critical_code_review_comments: mapa.tsx correctly uses base-extension WorkshopsMap (Metro resolves .native.tsx on native, .tsx on web) — proper platform split for react-native-maps.
Backend /api/comunas returns db.workshops.distinct('comuna') sorted — matches contract expected by chip row and confirmed sorted alphabetically in test.
Chip row uses horizontal ScrollView with hitSlop and 40px height meeting touch target guidelines.
mapa-screen uses SafeAreaView insets.top for header — good for notched devices.
WorkshopsMap.native.tsx correctly filters points requiring numeric lat/lng and uses fitToCoordinates to fit markers with edgePadding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature: Mapa tab. Web selectors: mapa-screen, comuna-all, comuna-{name} (e.g. comuna-Las Condes, comuna-Ñuñoa), map-web, map-row-{id}. Native selectors (Expo Go only, not testable in web preview): map-native, marker-{id}, map-card, map-card-close. Backend endpoint /api/comunas returns sorted list of unique comunas from workshops. 12 seeded workshops across 11 comunas. Las Condes has 2 workshops (Frenos Seguros Las Condes, AutoSpa Premium Wash).
